content: Models run through OpenRouter, and the prices shown are OpenRouter rates. Models marked BYOK run on your own provider key instead: the provider bills you for the tokens used, and only a service fee on that amount is charged to your wallet.

comment.text: Description at the top of the Models section of the AI settings page, shown when no service-fee percentage is known. OpenRouter is a product name and BYOK (bring your own key) is a label shown next to models; keep both untranslated.
